value: VRChat is an Early Access, free-to-play social platform designed to offer a limitless, user-created virtual universe. It enables players to explore hundreds of thousands of community-built worlds and games, embody diverse avatars for self-expression, and connect with various communities. While optimized for VR, VRChat provides extensive content creation tools (SDK, Unity, Udon) for users to build anything imaginable. Currently in Early Access, VRChat actively invites its passionate community to contribute feedback and creations, collaboratively shaping the platform's ongoing development.
